definition: Choosing where a facility (a data centre, tower, station or building) is located so that it avoids identified hazards. Does not include routes of cables or lines, or moving something already planned or built.
Choosing or changing the path of a cable, line or other linear infrastructure so that it avoids identified hazards. Does not include the location of facilities.
Moving infrastructure that is already built or already planned away from a hazard-exposed location. Does not include choosing a location for the first time.

Placing critical sites or facilities apart from each other (a recovery site in a different hazard zone) so that one event cannot damage them all. Does not include choosing a single site away from a hazard.

Choosing how infrastructure is deployed, without changing its location, because of a hazard: buried rather than aerial cable, or satellite rather than terrestrial links in hazard-prone areas. Does not include choosing or changing a location or route.
Avoids locations identified as having unacceptable hazard exposure
